full_prompt_en: A square dramatic landscape image follows a narrow double-track dirt lane from the lower foreground into an open field. The track bends left toward the horizon, with green grass growing between its pale ruts. Low flowering vegetation and crops border it on both sides. At the right middle distance stands a small white house with a dark roof, beside a full green tree. A few smaller trees mark the far left horizon. The land is simple and nearly level, occupying only the lower third of the frame. Above it, enormous dark blue-gray storm clouds take over the sky. Their layered, rolling forms sweep inward from the top and sides toward a break near the upper left center. Strong golden light pushes through that opening, tracing bright silver and amber edges around the nearest cloud banks. A separate orange glow runs along the far right horizon behind the tree and house. The lower field receives subdued green light, while the road catches just enough pale illumination to remain a clear route into the scene. Cloud texture is richly detailed, with swirling folds, hard illuminated rims and soft shadowed depths. Ground detail is finer and quieter, so the sky supplies the motion and drama. The small house is a steady vertical focus beneath the vast weather, its pale walls briefly bright against the darkening atmosphere. The overall composition draws the eye from the winding earth track to the distant building and upward into the luminous break, balancing calm rural geometry with a turbulent overhead mass.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形戏剧性风景图沿着一条窄窄的双轨土路，从下方前景进入开阔田野。道路向左弯向地平线，浅色车辙之间长着绿草。两侧贴着低矮开花植物和庄稼。右侧中景立着一座深屋顶小白屋，旁边是一棵丰茂绿树。几棵更小的树标示左方远处地平线。土地简单、近乎平坦，只占画面下方约三分之一。其上方，巨大的深蓝灰暴风云占据天空。层叠翻卷的云形从上方和两侧向左上方中心附近的缺口汇聚。强烈金光从裂口涌出，沿最近云团勾出明亮银色和琥珀色边缘。另一道橙光沿最右边地平线、树和房屋后方延伸。下方田地承接低调绿光，路面则接住足够的浅色照明，使其仍是一条清楚的入画路线。云层肌理十分丰富，有旋卷褶皱、清晰受光边和柔软深影。地面细节更细密也更安静，因此天空提供运动与戏剧感。小白屋成为浩大天气下稳定的竖向焦点，浅墙在渐暗空气中短暂发亮。整体构图从弯曲土路引导视线到远处房屋，再向上进入发光裂口，以平静乡野几何平衡头顶汹涌的巨大云团。
style_prompt_en: The image has a richly finished landscape surface with finely resolved ground detail beneath large, sculptural atmospheric forms. Dark navy and slate blue cover most of the frame, interrupted by concentrated gold and amber light and a narrow band of green below. Cloud edges vary from razor-bright rims to soft, rolling shadow, creating dramatic depth inside a single broad mass. A low horizon gives the upper field visual dominance. Near the bottom, a pale curving path supplies a clear route into the distance and connects small stable forms to the active sky. Light feels directional and momentary, breaking through dense layers and reflecting faintly across the darker ground. The color contrast is strong yet localized: the brightest warmth stays within gaps and edges, while cool tones retain wide areas. Fine texture and high tonal range make the scene vivid without cluttering its simple geometry. The overall rhythm runs from a quiet, grounded foreground to swirling, luminous movement overhead.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细致完成的风景表面，精细地面细节位于大型雕塑感空气团块之下。深海军蓝和石板蓝覆盖画面大部，集中金光、琥珀光和下方窄绿带打断它们。云边从刀锋般明亮的光缘变化到柔软翻卷的阴影，在一整块宽大团云内部创造戏剧纵深。低地平线让上方色域占据视觉主导。底部附近一条浅色弯曲路径提供明确的远行路线，把稳定的小形体连到活跃天空。光有方向且像瞬间闪现，穿透浓密层次，并在深色地面留下微弱反射。色彩对照强烈却集中：最亮暖色停在缺口和边缘，冷色仍占宽阔面积。细微肌理和高明暗范围令场景鲜明，却没有使简洁几何杂乱。整体节奏从安静落地的前景，升向头顶旋动发亮的气流。
theme_en: A winding dirt lane approaches a small white house beneath immense dark storm clouds split by golden light
theme_zh: 一条弯曲土路通向小白屋，头顶巨大的深色暴风云被金光撕开
name: Phil Koch
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
